layercake.title: Layer-Cake Stratigraphy
layercake.blurb: Undisturbed sedimentary layers, youngest on top. The simplest case: flat horizons interpolated straight through evenly spaced control points.

fold.title: Anticline & Syncline Fold
fold.blurb: Layers bent upward (anticline) and downward (syncline) by compressional stress. Sparse outcrop samples are interpolated into a continuous folded surface.

fault.title: Normal Fault
fault.blurb: Extensional stress breaks the layers and drops one block (the hanging wall) relative to the other (the footwall). Each fault block is interpolated separately, then offset by the fault throw.

unconformity.title: Angular Unconformity
unconformity.blurb: Older tilted/folded layers were eroded flat, then younger layers were deposited horizontally on top — a buried gap in geologic time.
